mapper.select: SELECT `id` AS 'id', `title` AS 'title', `link` AS 'link', `author` AS 'author', `pub_date` AS 'pubDate', `description` AS 'description', `price_sales` AS 'priceSales', `mallType` AS 'mallType', `cover` AS 'cover', `publisher` AS 'publisher', `adult` AS 'adult', `view` AS 'view' FROM `rebook`.`books` WHERE `id` = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT `id` AS 'id', `title` AS 'title', `link` AS 'link', `author` AS 'author', `pub_date` AS 'pubDate', `description` AS 'description', `price_sales` AS 'priceSales', `mallType` AS 'mallType', `cover` AS 'cover', `publisher` AS 'publisher', `adult` AS 'adult', `view` AS 'view' FROM `rebook`.`books`

SELECT `B`.`id` AS 'id', `B`.`title` AS 'title', `B`.`link` AS 'link', `B`.`author` AS 'author', `B`.`pub_date` AS 'pubDate', `B`.`description` AS 'description', `B`.`price_sales` AS 'priceSales', `B`.`mallType` AS 'mallType', `B`.`cover` AS 'cover', `B`.`publisher` AS 'publisher', `B`.`adult` AS 'adult', `B`.`view` AS 'view' FROM `rebook`.`books` AS `B` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `book_id`, COUNT(0) AS `cnt` FROM `rebook`.`reviews` WHERE `is_deleted` = FALSE GROUP BY `book_id`) AS `R` ON `R`.`book_id` = `B`.`id` ORDER BY (`B`.`view` + IFNULL(`R`.`cnt`, 0) * 10) DESC, `B`.`pub_date` DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT `id` AS 'id', `title` AS 'title', `link` AS 'link', `author` AS 'author', `pub_date` AS 'pubDate', `description` AS 'description', `price_sales` AS 'priceSales', `mallType` AS 'mallType', `cover` AS 'cover', `publisher` AS 'publisher', `adult` AS 'adult', `view` AS 'view' FROM `rebook`.`books` WHERE `pub_date` IS NOT NULL AND `pub_date` <= CURDATE() ORDER BY `pub_date` DESC LIMIT #{limit}
